dialogue.caption: Hey Stewie, you ever wonder how plants make their own food?
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: It's called photosynthesis, you simpleton. It's a biochemical process fundamental to most life on Earth.
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: Right! The plants use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into sugar!
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: Wait, you actually know that? Color me surprised.
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: Yeah, it happens in these tiny green things called chloroplasts. They're like little solar panels!
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: And they release oxygen as a byproduct, which we breathe.
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: Exactly! Without photosynthesis, we wouldn't have any oxygen!
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: Indeed. Plants are basically keeping us all alive.
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: So next time you see a tree, give it a little thank you!
dialogue.speaker: PETER
